name: Floor time with the baby
description: Mat work with your baby in the routine rather than waiting beside it. Every exercise is an ordinary one — the notes just say where the baby goes. For the stretch of the day they are happy on their back.

items.notes: On all fours with the baby on their back underneath you, face to face. Round your spine as you breathe out, let it drop as you breathe in.
Slow, and breathe out as you tilt. Baby lying next to you.
Undoing the shoulders-forward of a day spent carrying.
Baby sitting on your hips, or lying along your shins.
Baby lying beside your head so you can keep talking to them. Keep your lower back flat on the mat.
Baby on the mat in front of you.
Hands on the sofa, baby lying on it in front of you. Kiss at the top of each rep.
Baby in front of you, so lifting up is how you get to see them.
Baby just in front of your hands.
Start with the side you feed on most.
